name: Master Scale Reference
authority: Universal 3D production scale authority for Mythos Gates: Ascension.
rules: Normal enemies must occupy visibly less physical volume than the Deity.
Do not shrink Deities to fit the map; enlarge architecture and Gate landmarks.
Deity attacks use larger arcs, shockwaves, dust, terrain reaction, and camera weight.
The tactical grid expresses decisions, not literal human-sized squares.
Gates are landmarks visible from major battlefield zones and large enough to justify Deity travel.
Every 3D blueprint must reference this master scale system.
No asset creator or AI system may invent independent scale.
Deities must read as enormous in gameplay, not only promotional artwork.

scale.rule: Global reference anchors all 3D asset scale/material/style contracts.

mobilePerformanceTarget: Global reference for mobile tactical 3D production.

technicalNotes.collisionRequirements: Global reference only; asset packages define collision meshes.
